description: Source code implementing MD5 message-digest algorithm, including functions for MD5 initialization, update, padding, finalization, and cryptographic hashing with MD5, used for password hashing and related cryptographic operations.

methods.name: __md5_Init
methods.description: Initializes MD5 context with standard constants.

methods.name: __md5_Update
methods.description: Updates MD5 context with input data, processing in chunks.

methods.name: __md5_Pad
methods.description: Pads the MD5 message to align to block size and appends length.

methods.name: __md5_Final
methods.description: Finalizes MD5 digest, producing the hash output.

methods.name: __md5_Transform
methods.description: Performs MD5 transformation on a data block.

methods.name: md5_crypt
methods.description: Generates an MD5-based cryptographic hash of a password with salt, used for password hashing.
